breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'End slopes are zero,' which directly repeats the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt. A simply supported beam under uniform distributed load does rotate at the supports, so the end slopes are not zero. The ground truth prompt correctly omits this erroneous constraint entirely. The agent failed to identify and remove this inconsistency.
